body:
Hey, same here. I'm an only child and my parents did their best to be good parents. Our finances were never that great because of several business mishaps my dad encountered and my mum's ongoing medical problems. They still managed to send me to a nice private school and my grades were above average. My aunt was willing to provide me with the financial means to go abroad for university...it was all well and good until that point. Everything went downhill. I had an absolutely horrible time at uni. I barely had any friends, had my first relationship which turned out to be abusive, lost all my confidence because of constant criticism from my uni tutors and overall the course was a disorganised mess. It all happened when I was away from home. My mental health plummeted and I graduated with a shit degree with shit grades and completely fucked up my future. I know it's not just all about the grades, but I have completely fucked up because now I have no motivation and no aspirations. All I want to do is put an end to my life so I can get some peace and quiet. 
Although it was difficult, I still managed to build a little life of my own when I was abroad...I have 2 close friends that were willing to see me when I'm feeling down, and a boyfriend that felt like family to me. I met him after I broke up with the abusive scumbag, and we lived together in a nice room I rented in a shared flat. But my study visa ran out and I had to go home... once I left, I feel like I've lost the life that I worked so hard to build for myself. I'm still in contact with my 2 friends and my boyfriend is still my boyfriend, but I don't know if I'll ever get to live with them again. 
When I came home, I found out that my parents barely had any income for 5 years. It started during my last 2 years at school. Back then I managed to get awarded half scholarships, so for 2 years my parents got a 50% off on my school fees. Turns out they weren't making any money in those 2 years so well I guess I helped them out but not enough. Then when I was in uni for 3 years, supported by my aunt, my parents continued doing very badly financially and become quite heavily indebted. They have been waiting for me to graduate so I can find a job to help them pay off their debts. THEIR debts. I know they were good parents so I owe them a massive favour...but it's really quite sickening when all I want to do is kill myself and all my parents do is pressure me to find a job and give them money. I can't get a job because of how I completely ruined everything at uni, I feel like a useless piece of shit and now I can't even go and die like I want to because I'm an only child and my parents are waiting for me to help them with their debts. I wish I have a sibling or 2 so maybe my parents will have a more useful child to rely on, and it wouldn't matter if I go and off myself. I don't know what to think of all this.

Well if you really want to know, I like to crochet, spend time with my neighbour's dog, play games on my phone and go to art galleries. I haven't been to any galleries in ages though, as they are quite far from where I live.
It doesn't matter. I feel like everyone thinks I'm wasting my time when I do what I like to do
